content.title: Blood Sample
content.body:
§lArmor
    (Harvest Level 7 Required)
    §lTremor:
    - Shadow Steel: Made with an alloy of Shadow Iron and Lemurite (Nether: Y = 0-50).
    - Mutant Skeleton: Crafted with Mutant Skeleton parts.
    §lFuror:
    - Tenebrum: Found deep within the Midnight's caverns.
    - Haderoth: Made with an alloy of Rubracium (Overworld: Y = 10-40) and Mithril (Deep Caverns: Y = 10-64).
    §lArcum:
    - Meteor: Found in the Deep Caverns or in the End.
    §lDevout:
    - Rockshroom: Found in the surface of the Midnight
    - Ceruclase: Found in the Nether at any height
    §lBaubles
    - Improved Forsaken Ring
